newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major survives vote on health policy.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major survives vote on health policy.

text.p: Britain's Conservative government survived a vote over health policy on Tuesday night.
The government won through by 319 votes to 312, a margin of seven, after it offered a key ruling party rebel concessions for his local hospital and won support from Northern Irish MPs.
The vote on health policy, called by the opposition Labour party, was crucial for Major, who has lost his overall majority in the House of Commons, the lower parliamentary chamber.

Although a defeat would not have prompted a confidence motion, putting the future of his government at risk, it would have been a serious political embarrassment for Major and raised the prospect of him failing to hold on to power until May. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7768
